about: Golden fixtures for Shelf cover v1 (shared/cover/cover-v1.js). Every platform must reproduce every value exactly. Never regenerate these for v1; a change ships as cover-v2 with its own fixtures.
hashInput: hash is the sha256 of the normalised URL (contract 4.3) for board samples, and of the UTF-8 input string for seeds and probes; edge cases are hand-written.
palette: the winter rule of 2026-10-09 (README, Palette; flow decision 99): hues 150 to 320 degrees, chroma 0.7 of the board's; regenerated before the first ship, as the README allows

svg.sha256: lower-case hex sha256 of the SVG string as UTF-8
svg.drawing: the seam rule of 2026-10-04 (README, Drawing): every leaf fills its own square, ground included, 2 px oversize, and paints 4 px strips along the stretches of its cell edge its module touches

surface.use: light cards, mini player, Now playing

toast.use: the extension toast (ink in both themes)

probeMix.use: probe, not a Shelf surface: reaches the mixing step

probeFallback.use: probe, not a Shelf surface: reaches the text-colour fallback

probeFloor.use: probe, not a Shelf palette: no tint keeps 7:1, so the 6% floor is returned

reading.night: per article: night(hash).bg and .text; lineInk.readerNight is night(hash).line, which is lineInk on night.bg with night.muted as the text colour

leafFields: x, y: position in units (root square 8 x 8; with cols the squares continue to the right); s: size in units (8, 4, 2 or 1); d: depth; mod: module; rot: quarter turns; bg, fg: palette roles
